root_cause: The checkout-api container has no cpu resource request — the deployment manifest never sets resources.requests.cpu, so the HorizontalPodAutoscaler cannot compute CPU utilization (usage divided by request) for any pod. Every replica reports <unknown>/70% utilization and the HPA stays pinned at minReplicas while the pods are actually pegged.
evidence: deployment.yaml: the checkout-api container defines no resources block at all — no cpu request is set
kubectl-get-hpa.txt: TARGETS reads <unknown>/70%, meaning utilization cannot be computed
kubectl-describe-hpa.txt: FailedComputeMetricsReplicas — missing request for cpu
kubectl-top-pod.txt: metrics-server does report usage (roughly 900m per pod), so metrics flow and only the request is absent
fix: Set a cpu request on the checkout-api container in the deployment — add a resources.requests block (requests.cpu sized against observed usage, e.g. 500m, with a matching memory request) — so the HPA can compute utilization percentages and scale between minReplicas and maxReplicas.

patched_files.fixtures/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout-api
  namespace: shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout-api
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: checkout
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkout-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkout-api
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: checkout-api
      containers:
        - name: checkout-api
          image: checkoutprod0000.azurecr.io/checkout-api:v1.14.2
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
              value: prod
            - name: ORDER_SERVICE_URL
              value: http://orders-api.shop.svc.cluster.local:8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          terminationMessagePolicy: FallbackToLogsOnError
